summary: @yancyyu/agentcli ships auth/server code combining network exfiltration primitives with PATH modification
details: The package bundles code that combines shell command execution (ping, curl) with HTTP POST network calls in bin/lib/auth.mjs and src/main/server.ts, and modifies the installer's PATH environment via src/main/services/system-manager/SystemManagerConfigService.ts (including a reference to a ~/.hermit path). The co-occurrence of shell reconnaissance/exec primitives with outbound POST calls in an auth module, together with persistent PATH manipulation writing a package-controlled directory into the user's shell environment, matches the shape of installer-side data collection and persistence rather than a documented CLI workflow. Deeper tracing of this content was withheld by an upstream safety filter, which typically engages on code resembling operational credential-handling or exfiltration logic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
